children: Independent power producer Maxim Power said the Toronto Stock Exchange approved the company's request to renew its normal course issuer bid.
Under the plan, Maxim can purchase for cancellation up to 3.1 million common shares. As of Sept. 3, Maxim had some 64.4 million shares issued and outstanding, the company said.
The normal course issuer bid will begin on Sept. 16, and may continue to Sept. 15, 2027, the company added.
Maxim has a market cap of $192.16 million, and a public float of 13.18 million shares.
The company's stock was flat on the Toronto Stock Exchange, closing the day's session at C$4.15 ($2.99).
